sloka: ततस्तत्र मुहूर्त्तेन नद्य: पायसकर्दमा: ।उपातिष्ठन्त भरतं भरद्वाजस्य शासनात् ॥ २.९१.४०॥
transliteration: tatastatra muhūrttena nadya: pāyasakardamā: ।upātiṣṭhanta bharataṁ bharadvājasya śāsanāt ॥ 2.91.40॥

translations.english: First the ministers and priests took their respective seats in accordance with their rank, and then the army chief and finally the supervisor of the camp.
